description: teams.deleteTeam (DELETE /v1/teams/{teamId}) omits the 404 the live API returns for an already-deleted/missing team, so distilled's typed union lacks NotFound. The Team provider's idempotent delete branches on a typed NotFound tag (state persistence can fail after a successful delete, so delete must tolerate the team already being gone). Add the 404 response so the generator attaches the status-class NotFound error.
